raw_json.name: Pedidos cancelados por canal (versão B, mais completa)
raw_json.query:
SELECT p.canal AS canal, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(p.valor_total) AS valor
FROM pedidos p
WHERE p.status = 'cancelado' AND p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
GROUP BY 1

raw_json.name: Visão 360 do cliente – relatório detalhado
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 292 | Visão 360 do cliente – relatório detalhado
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  nf.cfop AS nf_cfop,
  pg.nsu AS pg_nsu,
  nf.chave AS nf_chave,
  u.email AS u_email,
  tk.dt_abertura AS tk_dt_abertura,
  pg.metodo AS pg_metodo,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_frete,
  pg.pag_id::text AS pg_pag_id,
  en.principal AS en_principal,
  c.dt_ultima_compra AS c_dt_ultima_compra,
  UPPER(TRIM(en.bairro)) AS en_bairro,
  c.nome AS c_nome,
  u.dt_ultimo_acesso AS u_dt_ultimo_acesso,
  en.logradouro AS en_logradouro,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  p.status AS p_status,
  p.forma_pagamento AS p_forma_pagamento,
  UPPER(TRIM(pg.status)) AS pg_status,
  p.qtd_itens AS p_qtd_itens,
  c.cli_id AS c_cli_id,
  nf.ped_id::text AS nf_ped_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(u.perfil)) AS u_perfil,
  tk.tempo_resposta_min AS tk_tempo_resposta_min,
  COALESCE(pg.parcelas, 0) AS pg_parcelas,
  tk.cli_id AS tk_cli_id,
  en.end_id AS en_end_id,
  nf.status AS nf_status,
  UPPER(TRIM(tk.prioridade)) AS tk_prioridade,
  u.ativo AS u_ativo,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_total
FROM clientes c
  LEFT JOIN enderecos en ON en.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON nf.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN tickets tk ON tk.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN usuarios_painel u ON u.usuario_id = tk.responsavel_id
WHERE c.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
ORDER BY c.dt_cadastro DESC

  LENGTH(COALESCE(u.nome, '')) AS u_nome_tam,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_total_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.cpf_cnpj)) AS c_cpf_cnpj_norm,
  TO_CHAR(c.dt_ultima_compra, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS c_dt_ultima_compra_fmt,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pg.valor, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pg.valor, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pg_valor_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.origem)) AS c_origem_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.serie)) AS nf_serie_norm
FROM clientes c
  LEFT JOIN enderecos en ON en.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON nf.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN tickets tk ON tk.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN usuarios_painel u ON u.usuario_id = tk.responsavel_id
WHERE c.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
  AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
ORDER BY c.dt_cadastro DESC

  UPPER(TRIM(m.ativo)) AS m_ativo_norm

  LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.sku = pr.sku
  LEFT JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
  LEFT JOIN precos pc ON pc.sku = pr.sku
  LEFT JOIN tabelas_preco tp ON tp.tabela_id = pc.tabela_id
  LEFT JOIN promocoes pm ON pm.sku = pr.sku
  LEFT JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.sku = pr.sku
WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
ORDER BY pr.dt_cadastro DESC

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 286 | Visão 360 financeira – relatório detalhado
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  ROUND(COALESCE(rt.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS rt_valor_frete,
  rt.dt_previsao AS rt_dt_previsao,
  rt.transportadora AS rt_transportadora,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_frete,
  TO_CHAR(c.dt_ultima_compra, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS c_dt_ultima_compra,
  rp.pag_id::text AS rp_pag_id,
  mp.mp_id AS mp_mp_id,
  p.valor_produtos AS p_valor_produtos,
  TO_CHAR(rp.dt_previsao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS rp_dt_previsao,
  c.dt_cadastro AS c_dt_cadastro,
  pg.ped_id::text AS pg_ped_id,
  nf.dt_emissao AS nf_dt_emissao,
  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id
FROM pagamentos pg
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pg.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  LEFT JOIN repasses rp ON rp.pag_id = pg.pag_id
  LEFT JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON nf.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN marketplace_pedidos mp ON mp.ped_id = p.ped_id
WHERE pg.dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
ORDER BY pg.dt_pagamento DESC

  LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN marketplace_pedidos mp ON mp.ped_id = p.ped_id

  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR nf.status = :status)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
ORDER BY pg.dt_pagamento DESC

  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.cidade, '')) AS c_cidade_tam,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM rt.dt_previsao)::int AS rt_dt_previsao_mes,
  ROUND(COALESCE(nf.valor_icms, 0)::numeric, 2) AS nf_valor_icms_arred,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.custo, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_custo_arred,
  ROUND(COALESCE(dv.valor_estorno, 0)::numeric, 2) AS dv_valor_estorno_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.cfop)) AS nf_cfop_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(l.status, '')) AS l_status_tam,
  TO_CHAR(c.dt_cadastro, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS c_dt_cadastro_fmt,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pg.status, '')) AS pg_status_tam,

  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.dt_cadastro)::int AS c_dt_cadastro_ano,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) AS c_status_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.serie)) AS nf_serie_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_frete_faixa,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pg.nsu, '')) AS pg_nsu_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(dv.motivo)) AS dv_motivo_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.ativo, '')) AS m_ativo_tam,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.dt_abertura)::int AS l_dt_abertura_ano,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM rt.dt_postagem)::int AS rt_dt_postagem_mes,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_desconto_faixa,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_frete_arred,
  COALESCE(pg.pag_id, 0) AS pg_pag_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.ativo)) AS m_ativo_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(rt.status, '')) AS rt_status_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(l.plano)) AS l_plano_norm,
  COALESCE(pr.categoria_id, 0) AS pr_categoria_id_zero,
  TO_CHAR(rt.dt_postagem, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS rt_dt_postagem_fmt,
  COALESCE(p.cli_id, 0) AS p_cli_id_zero,
  COALESCE(dv.dev_id, 0) AS dv_dev_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(ct.categoria_pai)) AS ct_categoria_pai_norm
FROM pedidos p
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN enderecos en ON en.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
  LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
  LEFT JOIN notas_fiscais nf ON nf.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN devolucoes dv ON dv.ped_id = p.ped_id
WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
ORDER BY p.dt_pedido DESC

raw_json.name: Marketplace por situação do pedido
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 280 | Marketplace por situação do pedido
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  p.status AS p_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd_distintos,
  SUM(c.limite_credito) AS soma_c_limite_credito,
  SUM(p.valor_produtos) AS soma_p_valor_produtos,
  AVG(p.valor_produtos) AS media_p_valor_produtos
FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

-- Consulta de teste 278 | Ranking de situação do pedido em Clientes recorrentes
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.status AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(pg.taxa) AS total
  FROM clientes c
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
    LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

name: Saldo por depósito – comparativo com o período anterior por marca ativa

raw_json.name: Saldo por depósito – comparativo com o período anterior por marca ativa
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 276 | Saldo por depósito – comparativo com o período anterior por marca ativa
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT m.ativo AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT e.est_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM estoque e
    INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR e.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT m.ativo AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT e.est_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM estoque e
    INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR e.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

-- Consulta de teste 275 | Entregas e rastreio – comparativo com o período anterior por transportadora
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT rt.transportadora AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ped_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_total) AS valor
  FROM pedidos p
    LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
    AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
    AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT rt.transportadora AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ped_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_total) AS valor
  FROM pedidos p
    LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
    AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
    AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

raw_json.name: Faturamento por loja – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 274 | Faturamento por loja – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', nf.dt_emissao)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS valor
  FROM notas_fiscais nf
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR nf.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

  COALESCE(pr.peso_kg, 0) AS pr_peso_kg_zero,

  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_desconto_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ncm, '')) AS pr_ncm_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.status)) AS p_status_norm,
  COALESCE(pi.ped_id, 0) AS pi_ped_id_zero,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dt_aprovacao)::int AS p_dt_aprovacao_ano,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.canal, '')) AS p_canal_tam,
  COALESCE(p.qtd_itens, 0) AS p_qtd_itens_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.cupom, '')) AS p_cupom_tam,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_total_faixa,

  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ativo, '')) AS pr_ativo_tam,

  UPPER(TRIM(pr.nome)) AS pr_nome_norm,
  COALESCE(pi.qtd, 0) AS pi_qtd_zero,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.canal)) AS p_canal_norm,
  COALESCE(p.id_loja, 0) AS p_id_loja_zero,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pi.preco_unit, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pi_preco_unit_arred,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dt_pedido)::int AS p_dt_pedido_ano,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_produtos_faixa,

  TO_CHAR(pr.dt_cadastro, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS pr_dt_cadastro_fmt
FROM pedido_itens pi
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pi.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)

name: Ranking de origem em Entregas e rastreio

raw_json.name: Ranking de origem em Entregas e rastreio
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 269 | Ranking de origem em Entregas e rastreio
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.origem AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ped_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(c.limite_credito) AS total
  FROM pedidos p
    LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
    AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

  COUNT(DISTINCT p.ped_id) AS qtd_distintos,

  LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id

  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
  AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min_registros
ORDER BY 4 DESC

  COALESCE(pr.prod_id, 0) AS pr_prod_id_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.uf, '')) AS d_uf_tam,
  COALESCE(pr.marca_id, 0) AS pr_marca_id_zero,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.dt_atualizacao)::int AS e_dt_atualizacao_ano,
  COALESCE(e.deposito_id, 0) AS e_deposito_id_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.tipo, '')) AS d_tipo_tam,
  COALESCE(e.est_id, 0) AS e_est_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(e.sku)) AS e_sku_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ncm)) AS pr_ncm_norm,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_ano,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_preco_faixa,
  COALESCE(pr.peso_kg, 0) AS pr_peso_kg_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.nome)) AS pr_nome_norm,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_mes,
  TO_CHAR(e.dt_atualizacao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS e_dt_atualizacao_fmt,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS e_custo_medio_faixa,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.custo, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_custo_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.ativo, '')) AS d_ativo_tam,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_custo_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(d.tipo)) AS d_tipo_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ativo)) AS pr_ativo_norm
FROM depositos d
  LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.deposito_id = d.deposito_id
  LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (d.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
ORDER BY e.dt_atualizacao DESC

raw_json.name: Ranking de cupom aplicado em Faturamento por loja
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 264 | Ranking de cupom aplicado em Faturamento por loja
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.cupom AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(nf.valor_nota) AS total
  FROM notas_fiscais nf
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (l.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: Boletos – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 263 | Boletos – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pg.dt_pagamento)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pg.pag_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pg.taxa) AS valor
  FROM pagamentos pg
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pg.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE pg.dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.name: Preço – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 253 | Preço – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pc.dt_vigencia_ini)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.preco_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM precos pc
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pc.sku
    INNER JOIN tabelas_preco tp ON tp.tabela_id = pc.tabela_id
  WHERE pc.dt_vigencia_ini BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.name: Marcas – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 250 | Marcas – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.dt_cadastro)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.marca_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM marcas m
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.marca_id = m.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pr.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

SELECT

  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id,

  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  c.cli_id AS c_cli_id,
  c.nome AS c_nome,
  c.email AS c_email,
  c.cpf_cnpj AS c_cpf_cnpj,
  c.tipo_pessoa AS c_tipo_pessoa,
  c.dt_cadastro AS c_dt_cadastro,
  c.uf AS c_uf,
  c.cidade AS c_cidade,
  c.status AS c_status,
  c.origem AS c_origem,
  c.limite_credito AS c_limite_credito,
  c.dt_ultima_compra AS c_dt_ultima_compra,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.canal)) AS p_canal_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.origem)) AS c_origem_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.status)) AS p_status_norm,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_desconto_arred,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.dt_pedido)::int AS p_dt_pedido_mes,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(nf.numero, '')) AS nf_numero_tam,
  TO_CHAR(c.dt_cadastro, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS c_dt_cadastro_fmt,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.email, '')) AS c_email_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_frete_arred,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.dt_aprovacao)::int AS p_dt_aprovacao_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.cpf_cnpj)) AS c_cpf_cnpj_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.origem, '')) AS c_origem_tam,
  COALESCE(p.cli_id, 0) AS p_cli_id_zero,
  TO_CHAR(nf.dt_emissao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS nf_dt_emissao_fmt,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.dt_ultima_compra)::int AS c_dt_ultima_compra_ano,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.status, '')) AS c_status_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.email)) AS c_email_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.tipo_pessoa, '')) AS c_tipo_pessoa_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(nf.chave, '')) AS nf_chave_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.limite_credito, 0)::numeric, 2) AS c_limite_credito_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.cidade)) AS c_cidade_norm,
  COALESCE(p.qtd_itens, 0) AS p_qtd_itens_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(nf.status, '')) AS nf_status_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.cidade, '')) AS c_cidade_tam,
  COALESCE(c.cli_id, 0) AS c_cli_id_zero,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM nf.dt_emissao)::int AS nf_dt_emissao_ano,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.serie)) AS nf_serie_norm,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_aprovacao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS p_dt_aprovacao_fmt,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_pedido, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS p_dt_pedido_fmt,
  COALESCE(nf.ped_id, 0) AS nf_ped_id_zero,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_desconto_faixa,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_produtos_arred,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(nf.valor_icms, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(nf.valor_icms, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS nf_valor_icms_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.forma_pagamento)) AS p_forma_pagamento_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.numero)) AS nf_numero_norm,
  ROUND(COALESCE(nf.valor_nota, 0)::numeric, 2) AS nf_valor_nota_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.status)) AS nf_status_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.limite_credito, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(c.limite_credito, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS c_limite_credito_faixa,
  COALESCE(p.id_loja, 0) AS p_id_loja_zero,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.dt_cadastro)::int AS c_dt_cadastro_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.tipo_pessoa)) AS c_tipo_pessoa_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.status)) AS c_status_norm,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dt_pedido)::int AS p_dt_pedido_ano,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.uf)) AS c_uf_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.status, '')) AS p_status_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.uf, '')) AS c_uf_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_total_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.canal, '')) AS p_canal_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.cupom)) AS p_cupom_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_frete_faixa,

  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_total_faixa,
  COALESCE(nf.nf_id, 0) AS nf_nf_id_zero,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(nf.valor_nota, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(nf.valor_nota, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS nf_valor_nota_faixa,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.cupom, '')) AS p_cupom_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.cfop)) AS nf_cfop_norm,
  TO_CHAR(c.dt_ultima_compra, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS c_dt_ultima_compra_fmt,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(nf.serie, '')) AS nf_serie_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.chave)) AS nf_chave_norm,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM nf.dt_emissao)::int AS nf_dt_emissao_mes,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dt_aprovacao)::int AS p_dt_aprovacao_ano,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.nome)) AS c_nome_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(c.cpf_cnpj, '')) AS c_cpf_cnpj_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(nf.valor_icms, 0)::numeric, 2) AS nf_valor_icms_arred,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_produtos_faixa,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM c.dt_ultima_compra)::int AS c_dt_ultima_compra_mes,
  COALESCE(p.ped_id, 0) AS p_ped_id_zero
FROM notas_fiscais nf
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 247 | Clientes recorrentes – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.dt_pedido)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pg.taxa) AS valor
  FROM clientes c
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
    LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

-- Consulta de teste 246 | Ranking de tipo de pessoa em Clientes
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.tipo_pessoa AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(c.limite_credito) AS total
  FROM clientes c
    LEFT JOIN enderecos en ON en.cli_id = c.cli_id AND en.principal = 'S'
  WHERE c.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.sku, '')) AS pr_sku_tam,
  COALESCE(e.est_id, 0) AS e_est_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.nome)) AS pr_nome_norm,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.dt_atualizacao)::int AS e_dt_atualizacao_ano,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.ativo, '')) AS m_ativo_tam,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.dt_atualizacao)::int AS e_dt_atualizacao_mes,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_preco_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(d.ativo)) AS d_ativo_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.nome, '')) AS d_nome_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.ativo, '')) AS d_ativo_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(d.tipo)) AS d_tipo_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ativo)) AS pr_ativo_norm,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.sku)) AS pr_sku_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.nome, '')) AS pr_nome_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0)::numeric, 2) AS e_custo_medio_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(e.sku)) AS e_sku_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_custo_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.nome)) AS m_nome_norm,
  COALESCE(pr.prod_id, 0) AS pr_prod_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ncm)) AS pr_ncm_norm,
  COALESCE(pr.categoria_id, 0) AS pr_categoria_id_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(e.sku, '')) AS e_sku_tam,
  COALESCE(pr.peso_kg, 0) AS pr_peso_kg_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.fabricante)) AS m_fabricante_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(d.nome)) AS d_nome_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.fabricante, '')) AS m_fabricante_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.uf, '')) AS d_uf_tam,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS e_custo_medio_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.ativo)) AS m_ativo_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(d.tipo, '')) AS d_tipo_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.nome, '')) AS m_nome_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ativo, '')) AS pr_ativo_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.pais_origem, '')) AS m_pais_origem_tam,
  COALESCE(e.qtd_disponivel, 0) AS e_qtd_disponivel_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(d.uf)) AS d_uf_norm
FROM estoque e
  INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
  LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
  LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
ORDER BY e.dt_atualizacao DESC
LIMIT :limite

-- Consulta de teste 240 | Conciliação de cartão – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pg.dt_pagamento)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pg.pag_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(rp.valor_bruto) AS valor
  FROM pagamentos pg
    LEFT JOIN repasses rp ON rp.pag_id = pg.pag_id
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pg.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE pg.dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 239 | Ranking de cupom aplicado em Pedidos Amazon
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.cupom AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(mp.comissao) AS total
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado

-- Consulta de teste 234 | Notas fiscais emitidas por cupom aplicado

  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  TO_CHAR(nf.dt_emissao, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes_referencia,
  COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
  COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS qtd_distintos,
  SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS soma_p_valor_desconto
FROM notas_fiscais nf

  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

-- Consulta de teste 232 | Pedidos Shopee – extrato completo ampliado (91 campos)
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT

  mp.ped_id AS mp_ped_id,
  mp.marketplace AS mp_marketplace,
  mp.id_externo AS mp_id_externo,
  mp.status_externo AS mp_status_externo,
  mp.comissao AS mp_comissao,
  mp.dt_importacao AS mp_dt_importacao,
  mp.valor_repasse AS mp_valor_repasse,
  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id,
  p.cli_id AS p_cli_id,
  p.id_loja AS p_id_loja,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_pedido, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS p_dt_pedido,
  p.status AS p_status,
  p.canal AS p_canal,
  p.forma_pagamento AS p_forma_pagamento,
  p.valor_produtos AS p_valor_produtos,
  p.valor_frete AS p_valor_frete,
  p.valor_desconto AS p_valor_desconto,
  p.valor_total AS p_valor_total,
  p.qtd_itens AS p_qtd_itens,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  rt.rast_id::text AS rt_rast_id,
  rt.ped_id AS rt_ped_id,
  rt.transportadora AS rt_transportadora,
  rt.codigo AS rt_codigo,
  rt.status AS rt_status,
  rt.dt_postagem AS rt_dt_postagem,
  rt.dt_previsao AS rt_dt_previsao,
  rt.dt_entrega AS rt_dt_entrega,
  ROUND(COALESCE(rt.valor_frete, 0)::numeric, 2) AS rt_valor_frete,
  COALESCE(rt.ped_id, 0) AS rt_ped_id_zero,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_produtos, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_produtos_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.forma_pagamento)) AS p_forma_pagamento_norm,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_desconto, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_desconto_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(rt.status, '')) AS rt_status_tam,

-- Consulta de teste 228 | SKU e estoque – comparativo com o período anterior por sku
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT e.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prod_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM produtos pr
    LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.sku = pr.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT e.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prod_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM produtos pr
    LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.sku = pr.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR nf.status = :status)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pagamentos ax
    WHERE ax.ped_id = nf.ped_id AND ax.status = 'pago'
  )
ORDER BY nf.dt_emissao DESC

-- Consulta de teste 220 | Lojas ativas – extrato completo (58 campos)
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  l.loja_id AS l_loja_id,
  l.nome AS l_nome,
  l.cnpj AS l_cnpj,
  l.uf AS l_uf,
  l.status AS l_status,
  l.dt_abertura AS l_dt_abertura,
  l.plano AS l_plano,
  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id,
  p.cli_id AS p_cli_id,
  p.id_loja AS p_id_loja,
  p.dt_pedido AS p_dt_pedido,
  p.status AS p_status,
  p.canal AS p_canal,
  p.forma_pagamento AS p_forma_pagamento,
  p.valor_produtos AS p_valor_produtos,
  p.valor_frete AS p_valor_frete,
  p.valor_desconto AS p_valor_desconto,
  p.valor_total AS p_valor_total,
  p.qtd_itens AS p_qtd_itens,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.forma_pagamento, '')) AS p_forma_pagamento_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.status)) AS p_status_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(p.valor_frete, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS p_valor_frete_faixa,
  COALESCE(l.loja_id, 0) AS l_loja_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.forma_pagamento)) AS p_forma_pagamento_norm,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.dt_abertura)::int AS l_dt_abertura_mes,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(l.status, '')) AS l_status_tam,
  COALESCE(p.qtd_itens, 0) AS p_qtd_itens_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(l.cnpj, '')) AS l_cnpj_tam,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.dt_pedido)::int AS p_dt_pedido_mes,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(l.plano, '')) AS l_plano_tam,
  TO_CHAR(l.dt_abertura, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS l_dt_abertura_fmt,
  UPPER(TRIM(l.nome)) AS l_nome_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(l.plano)) AS l_plano_norm,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.dt_abertura)::int AS l_dt_abertura_ano,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dt_pedido)::int AS p_dt_pedido_ano,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.cupom)) AS p_cupom_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.canal)) AS p_canal_norm,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.dt_aprovacao)::int AS p_dt_aprovacao_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(l.cnpj)) AS l_cnpj_norm,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_aprovacao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS p_dt_aprovacao_fmt,

raw_json.name: Produtos mais vendidos – comparativo com o período anterior por sku
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 214 | Produtos mais vendidos – comparativo com o período anterior por sku
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT pi.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.item_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM pedido_itens pi
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pi.ped_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT pi.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.item_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM pedido_itens pi
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pi.ped_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

raw_json.name: Ranking de sku em Depósitos
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 210 | Ranking de sku em Depósitos
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    pr.sku AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.deposito_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS total
  FROM depositos d
    LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.deposito_id = d.deposito_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (d.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: Preço sem promoção
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 205 | Preço sem promoção
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  pr.ncm AS pr_ncm,
  tp.moeda AS tp_moeda,
  pr.categoria_id AS pr_categoria_id,
  pr.nome AS pr_nome,
  pc.preco_id AS pc_preco_id,
  pr.preco AS pr_preco,
  TO_CHAR(pc.dt_vigencia_ini, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS pc_dt_vigencia_ini,
  pc.tabela_id::text AS pc_tabela_id,
  pr.ativo AS pr_ativo,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.custo, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_custo,
  pc.preco AS pc_preco
FROM precos pc
  INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pc.sku
  INNER JOIN tabelas_preco tp ON tp.tabela_id = pc.tabela_id
WHERE pc.dt_vigencia_ini BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM promocoes ax
    WHERE ax.sku = pc.sku
  )
ORDER BY pc.dt_vigencia_ini DESC

name: Ranking de país de origem em Promoções ativas

raw_json.name: Ranking de país de origem em Promoções ativas
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 204 | Ranking de país de origem em Promoções ativas
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.pais_origem AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.promo_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS total
  FROM promocoes pm
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pm.sku
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  WHERE pm.dt_inicio BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: Pedidos Amazon – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 202 | Pedidos Amazon – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.dt_importacao)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(mp.comissao) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

-- Consulta de teste 199 | Ranking de forma de pagamento em Pedidos com devolução
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.forma_pagamento AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ped_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(p.valor_produtos) AS total
  FROM pedidos p
    INNER JOIN devolucoes dv ON dv.ped_id = p.ped_id
    INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE dv.dt_solicitacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: Atendimento – comparativo com o período anterior por prioridade
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 196 | Atendimento – comparativo com o período anterior por prioridade
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT tk.prioridade AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT tk.tk_id) AS qtd, COUNT(*) AS valor
  FROM tickets tk
    LEFT JOIN usuarios_painel u ON u.usuario_id = tk.responsavel_id
  WHERE tk.dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT tk.prioridade AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT tk.tk_id) AS qtd, COUNT(*) AS valor
  FROM tickets tk
    LEFT JOIN usuarios_painel u ON u.usuario_id = tk.responsavel_id
  WHERE tk.dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

-- Consulta de teste 193 | Lojas ativas – comparativo com o período anterior por plano contratado
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT l.plano AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loja_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_frete) AS valor
  FROM lojas l
    LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.id_loja = l.loja_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT l.plano AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loja_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_frete) AS valor
  FROM lojas l
    LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.id_loja = l.loja_id
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

-- Consulta de teste 189 | Ranking de situação do pedido em Magalu e Americanas
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.status AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(mp.valor_repasse) AS total
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (l.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

-- Consulta de teste 183 | Derivações de produto – comparativo com o período anterior por fabricante

/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT m.fabricante AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prod_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM produtos pr
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT m.fabricante AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prod_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM produtos pr
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur

raw_json.name: Depósitos – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 172 | Depósitos – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', e.dt_atualizacao)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.deposito_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM depositos d
    LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.deposito_id = d.deposito_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (d.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 166 | Estoque – comparativo com o período anterior por sku
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT pr.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT e.est_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM estoque e
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
    INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT pr.sku AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT e.est_id) AS qtd, SUM(pr.preco) AS valor
  FROM estoque e
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
    INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id
  WHERE e.dt_atualizacao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

raw_json.name: Ranking de assunto em Tickets de suporte
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 162 | Ranking de assunto em Tickets de suporte
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tk.assunto AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tk.tk_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(c.limite_credito) AS total
  FROM tickets tk
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = tk.cli_id
    LEFT JOIN usuarios_painel u ON u.usuario_id = tk.responsavel_id
  WHERE tk.dt_abertura BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR tk.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

-- Consulta de teste 160 | Faturamento – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', nf.dt_emissao)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(p.valor_frete) AS valor
  FROM notas_fiscais nf
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 157 | Recebíveis – comparativo com o período anterior por canal de venda
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT p.canal AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pg.pag_id) AS qtd, SUM(rp.valor_liquido) AS valor
  FROM pagamentos pg
    LEFT JOIN repasses rp ON rp.pag_id = pg.pag_id
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pg.ped_id
  WHERE pg.dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT p.canal AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT pg.pag_id) AS qtd, SUM(rp.valor_liquido) AS valor
  FROM pagamentos pg
    LEFT JOIN repasses rp ON rp.pag_id = pg.pag_id
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pg.ped_id
  WHERE pg.dt_pagamento BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

raw_json.name: Logs de integração – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 151 | Logs de integração – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', li.dt_evento)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT li.log_id) AS distintos,
    COUNT(*) AS valor
  FROM logs_integracao li
    INNER JOIN integracoes ig ON ig.integracao_id = li.integracao_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = ig.id_loja
  WHERE li.dt_evento BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR l.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.name: Descontos concedidos – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 145 | Descontos concedidos – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.dt_pedido)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pi.item_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pi.preco_unit) AS valor
  FROM pedido_itens pi
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = pi.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pi.sku
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
    AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.name: Vendas por canal – relatório detalhado
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 142 | Vendas por canal – relatório detalhado
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  p.id_loja::text AS p_id_loja,
  pi.ped_id AS pi_ped_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(p.status)) AS p_status,
  p.dt_pedido AS p_dt_pedido,
  l.nome AS l_nome,
  l.cnpj AS l_cnpj,
  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  pi.preco_unit AS pi_preco_unit,
  p.forma_pagamento AS p_forma_pagamento,
  l.plano AS l_plano,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  pi.dt_inclusao AS pi_dt_inclusao,
  p.cli_id AS p_cli_id,
  p.valor_produtos AS p_valor_produtos,
  pi.custo_unit AS pi_custo_unit,
  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id,
  TO_CHAR(l.dt_abertura, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS l_dt_abertura,
  p.qtd_itens AS p_qtd_itens,
  pi.sku AS pi_sku,
  l.status AS l_status
FROM pedidos p
  LEFT JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
  AND (l.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
ORDER BY p.dt_pedido DESC
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: Faturamento por situação do pedido
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 141 | Faturamento por situação do pedido
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  p.status AS p_status,
  c.origem AS c_origem,
  COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
  COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS qtd_distintos,
  SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS soma_p_valor_desconto,
  AVG(p.valor_desconto) AS media_p_valor_desconto,
  SUM(p.valor_produtos) AS soma_p_valor_produtos,
  MAX(nf.dt_emissao) AS ultima_data
FROM notas_fiscais nf
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min_registros
ORDER BY 3 DESC

raw_json.name: Marketplace – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 139 | Marketplace – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.dt_importacao)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(p.valor_produtos) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

-- Consulta de teste 136 | Ranking de cupom aplicado em Clientes e pedidos
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.cupom AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(c.limite_credito) AS total
  FROM clientes c
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

raw_json.name: NF-e rejeitadas – comparativo com o período anterior por forma de pagamento
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 132 | NF-e rejeitadas – comparativo com o período anterior por forma de pagamento
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT p.forma_pagamento AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS qtd, SUM(nf.valor_icms) AS valor
  FROM notas_fiscais nf
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR nf.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT p.forma_pagamento AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT nf.nf_id) AS qtd, SUM(nf.valor_icms) AS valor
  FROM notas_fiscais nf
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR p.id_loja = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR nf.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

-- Consulta de teste 130 | Ranking de categoria pai em Produtos
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ct.categoria_pai AS dimensao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.prod_id) AS qtd,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS total
  FROM produtos pr
    LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
    LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
  WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS posicao,
  dimensao,
  qtd,
  total,
  ROUND(100.0 * total / NULLIF(SUM(total) OVER (), 0), 2) AS participacao_pct,
  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base
ORDER BY posicao
LIMIT :limite

-- Consulta de teste 128 | Usuários do painel – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga

WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.dt_ultimo_acesso)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.usuario_id) AS distintos,
    COUNT(*) AS valor

)

  registros,

  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

name: Magalu e Americanas – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido

raw_json.name: Magalu e Americanas – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 127 | Magalu e Americanas – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT p.status AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (l.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT p.status AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (l.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

name: Cadastro de clientes por origem – evolução mensal

raw_json.name: Cadastro de clientes por origem – evolução mensal
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 122 | Cadastro de clientes por origem – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', c.dt_cadastro)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(c.limite_credito) AS valor
  FROM clientes c
    LEFT JOIN enderecos en ON en.cli_id = c.cli_id
  WHERE c.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

-- Consulta de teste 121 | Tabela de preços – evolução mensal
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH mensal AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', pc.dt_vigencia_ini)::date AS mes,
    COUNT(*) AS registros,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.preco_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM precos pc
    INNER JOIN tabelas_preco tp ON tp.tabela_id = pc.tabela_id
    LEFT JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = pc.sku
  WHERE pc.dt_vigencia_ini BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pc.sku = :sku)
    AND (tp.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  mes,
  registros,
  distintos,
  valor,
  valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS variacao_abs,
  ROUND(100.0 * (valor - LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes)) / NULLIF(LAG(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes), 0), 2) AS variacao_pct
FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

-- Consulta de teste 119 | Derivações de produto – relatório detalhado

SELECT
  pr.preco AS pr_preco,
  ct.ativo AS ct_ativo,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.pais_origem)) AS m_pais_origem,
  ct.categoria_id::text AS ct_categoria_id,
  pr.sku AS pr_sku,
  ct.categoria_pai AS ct_categoria_pai,
  pr.categoria_id AS pr_categoria_id,
  pr.dt_cadastro AS pr_dt_cadastro,
  pr.prod_id AS pr_prod_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.nome)) AS pr_nome,
  pr.ativo AS pr_ativo,

  pr.ncm AS pr_ncm

  LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id

  SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY total DESC) AS acumulado
FROM base

name: Pedidos Shopee – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido

raw_json.name: Pedidos Shopee – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 115 | Pedidos Shopee – comparativo com o período anterior por situação do pedido
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT p.status AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT p.status AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(p.valor_desconto) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    LEFT JOIN rastreios rt ON rt.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 114 | SKU e estoque – extrato completo (59 campos)
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  pr.prod_id AS pr_prod_id,
  pr.sku AS pr_sku,
  pr.nome AS pr_nome,
  pr.marca_id::text AS pr_marca_id,
  pr.categoria_id AS pr_categoria_id,
  pr.preco AS pr_preco,
  pr.custo AS pr_custo,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ativo)) AS pr_ativo,
  pr.dt_cadastro AS pr_dt_cadastro,
  pr.peso_kg AS pr_peso_kg,
  pr.ncm AS pr_ncm,
  e.est_id AS e_est_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(e.sku)) AS e_sku,
  e.deposito_id AS e_deposito_id,
  e.qtd_disponivel AS e_qtd_disponivel,
  e.qtd_reservada AS e_qtd_reservada,
  e.qtd_minima AS e_qtd_minima,
  e.custo_medio AS e_custo_medio,
  e.dt_atualizacao AS e_dt_atualizacao,
  m.marca_id AS m_marca_id,
  m.nome AS m_nome,
  m.fabricante AS m_fabricante,
  m.pais_origem AS m_pais_origem,
  m.ativo AS m_ativo,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.custo, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_custo_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(e.sku)) AS e_sku_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.ativo, '')) AS m_ativo_tam,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS e_custo_medio_faixa,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.dt_atualizacao)::int AS e_dt_atualizacao_mes,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ativo)) AS pr_ativo_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.fabricante, '')) AS m_fabricante_tam,
  COALESCE(e.est_id, 0) AS e_est_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.nome)) AS m_nome_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_custo_faixa,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_mes,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.dt_atualizacao)::int AS e_dt_atualizacao_ano,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.sku, '')) AS pr_sku_tam,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.preco, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_preco_arred,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_preco_faixa,
  TO_CHAR(e.dt_atualizacao, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS e_dt_atualizacao_fmt,
  COALESCE(pr.marca_id, 0) AS pr_marca_id_zero,
  ROUND(COALESCE(e.custo_medio, 0)::numeric, 2) AS e_custo_medio_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(e.sku, '')) AS e_sku_tam,
  COALESCE(e.deposito_id, 0) AS e_deposito_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.sku)) AS pr_sku_norm,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_ano,
  COALESCE(pr.prod_id, 0) AS pr_prod_id_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.nome, '')) AS m_nome_tam,
  COALESCE(e.qtd_disponivel, 0) AS e_qtd_disponivel_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.pais_origem, '')) AS m_pais_origem_tam,
  TO_CHAR(pr.dt_cadastro, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS pr_dt_cadastro_fmt,
  COALESCE(pr.categoria_id, 0) AS pr_categoria_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ncm)) AS pr_ncm_norm,
  COALESCE(pr.peso_kg, 0) AS pr_peso_kg_zero,
  COALESCE(e.qtd_reservada, 0) AS e_qtd_reservada_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.ativo)) AS m_ativo_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.pais_origem)) AS m_pais_origem_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.fabricante)) AS m_fabricante_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ncm, '')) AS pr_ncm_tam
FROM produtos pr
  LEFT JOIN estoque e ON e.sku = pr.sku
  LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
ORDER BY pr.dt_cadastro DESC

/* valores monetários em reais */
WITH atual AS (
  SELECT p.canal AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(mp.comissao) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
),
anterior AS (
  SELECT p.canal AS dimensao, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.mp_id) AS qtd, SUM(mp.comissao) AS valor
  FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
    INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
    INNER JOIN pedido_itens pi ON pi.ped_id = p.ped_id
  WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio_anterior AND :data_fim_anterior
    AND (:status IS NULL OR p.status = :status)
    AND (:sku IS NULL OR pi.sku = :sku)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cur.dimensao, prev.dimensao) AS dimensao,
  COALESCE(cur.qtd, 0) AS qtd_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.qtd, 0) AS qtd_anterior,
  COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) AS valor_atual,
  COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) AS valor_anterior,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(prev.valor, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(cur.valor, 0) - prev.valor) / prev.valor, 2)
  END AS variacao_pct
FROM atual cur
  FULL OUTER JOIN anterior prev ON prev.dimensao = cur.dimensao
ORDER BY valor_atual DESC

-- Consulta de teste 109 | Derivações de produto – extrato completo ampliado (57 campos)
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  pr.prod_id AS pr_prod_id,
  pr.sku AS pr_sku,
  pr.nome AS pr_nome,
  pr.marca_id AS pr_marca_id,
  pr.categoria_id AS pr_categoria_id,
  pr.preco AS pr_preco,
  pr.custo AS pr_custo,
  pr.ativo AS pr_ativo,
  pr.dt_cadastro AS pr_dt_cadastro,
  pr.peso_kg AS pr_peso_kg,
  pr.ncm AS pr_ncm,
  m.marca_id AS m_marca_id,
  m.nome AS m_nome,
  m.fabricante AS m_fabricante,
  m.pais_origem AS m_pais_origem,
  m.ativo AS m_ativo,
  ct.categoria_id AS ct_categoria_id,
  ct.nome AS ct_nome,
  ct.categoria_pai AS ct_categoria_pai,
  ct.nivel AS ct_nivel,
  ct.ativo AS ct_ativo,
  COALESCE(pr.prod_id, 0) AS pr_prod_id_zero,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.preco, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_preco_arred,
  UPPER(TRIM(ct.categoria_pai)) AS ct_categoria_pai_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.nome, '')) AS m_nome_tam,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_ano,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pr.dt_cadastro)::int AS pr_dt_cadastro_mes,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.custo, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_custo_faixa,
  COALESCE(ct.nivel, 0) AS ct_nivel_zero,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pr.custo, 0)::numeric, 2) AS pr_custo_arred,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(ct.ativo, '')) AS ct_ativo_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.sku, '')) AS pr_sku_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.nome)) AS pr_nome_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.ativo, '')) AS m_ativo_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ncm, '')) AS pr_ncm_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ativo)) AS pr_ativo_norm,
  TO_CHAR(pr.dt_cadastro, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS pr_dt_cadastro_fmt,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.sku)) AS pr_sku_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(ct.ativo)) AS ct_ativo_norm,
  COALESCE(m.marca_id, 0) AS m_marca_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(ct.nome)) AS ct_nome_norm,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 1000 THEN 'alto' WHEN COALESCE(pr.preco, 0) > 100 THEN 'medio' ELSE 'baixo' END AS pr_preco_faixa,
  UPPER(TRIM(pr.ncm)) AS pr_ncm_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.ativo, '')) AS pr_ativo_tam,
  COALESCE(pr.categoria_id, 0) AS pr_categoria_id_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(ct.nome, '')) AS ct_nome_tam,
  COALESCE(pr.peso_kg, 0) AS pr_peso_kg_zero,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.pais_origem, '')) AS m_pais_origem_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(pr.nome, '')) AS pr_nome_tam,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.nome)) AS m_nome_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.fabricante)) AS m_fabricante_norm,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(m.fabricante, '')) AS m_fabricante_tam,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(ct.categoria_pai, '')) AS ct_categoria_pai_tam,
  COALESCE(pr.marca_id, 0) AS pr_marca_id_zero,
  COALESCE(ct.categoria_id, 0) AS ct_categoria_id_zero,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.pais_origem)) AS m_pais_origem_norm,
  UPPER(TRIM(m.ativo)) AS m_ativo_norm
FROM produtos pr
  LEFT JOIN marcas m ON m.marca_id = pr.marca_id
  LEFT JOIN categorias ct ON ct.categoria_id = pr.categoria_id
WHERE pr.dt_cadastro BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (pr.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
ORDER BY pr.dt_cadastro DESC

-- Consulta de teste 102 | Estoque – evolução mensal

WITH mensal AS (

    DATE_TRUNC('month', e.dt_atualizacao)::date AS mes,

    COUNT(DISTINCT e.est_id) AS distintos,
    SUM(pr.custo) AS valor
  FROM estoque e
    INNER JOIN produtos pr ON pr.sku = e.sku
    INNER JOIN depositos d ON d.deposito_id = e.deposito_id

)

FROM mensal
ORDER BY mes

raw_json.name: Faturamento sem pagamento confirmado
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 094 | Faturamento sem pagamento confirmado
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  c.nome AS c_nome,
  nf.dt_emissao AS nf_dt_emissao,
  p.valor_frete AS p_valor_frete,
  UPPER(TRIM(nf.status)) AS nf_status,
  nf.ped_id AS nf_ped_id,
  c.cli_id::text AS c_cli_id,
  ROUND(COALESCE(nf.valor_icms, 0)::numeric, 2) AS nf_valor_icms,
  c.email AS c_email,
  UPPER(TRIM(c.cpf_cnpj)) AS c_cpf_cnpj,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.limite_credito, 0)::numeric, 2) AS c_limite_credito,
  c.status AS c_status,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao
FROM notas_fiscais nf
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = nf.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.cli_id = p.cli_id
WHERE nf.dt_emissao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:status IS NULL OR c.status = :status)
  AND (:uf IS NULL OR c.uf = :uf)
  AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pagamentos ax
    WHERE ax.ped_id = nf.ped_id AND ax.status = 'pago'
  )
ORDER BY nf.dt_emissao DESC

raw_json.name: Clientes recorrentes por cidade
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 093 | Clientes recorrentes por cidade
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  c.cidade AS c_cidade,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_pedido, 'YYYY-MM') AS mes_referencia,
  COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.cli_id) AS qtd_distintos,
  SUM(c.limite_credito) AS soma_c_limite_credito,
  SUM(p.valor_frete) AS soma_p_valor_frete,
  AVG(p.valor_frete) AS media_p_valor_frete,
  MAX(p.dt_pedido) AS ultima_data
FROM clientes c
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.cli_id = c.cli_id
  LEFT JOIN pagamentos pg ON pg.ped_id = p.ped_id
WHERE p.dt_pedido BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (c.nome ILIKE '%' || :busca || '%' OR :busca IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) >= :min_registros
ORDER BY 3 DESC

raw_json.name: Magalu e Americanas sem rastreio
raw_json.query:
-- Consulta de teste 092 | Magalu e Americanas sem rastreio
-- Dados fictícios, gerada para teste de carga
/* valores monetários em reais */
SELECT
  p.ped_id AS p_ped_id,
  p.cli_id AS p_cli_id,
  UPPER(TRIM(l.cnpj)) AS l_cnpj,
  p.dt_aprovacao AS p_dt_aprovacao,
  UPPER(TRIM(mp.id_externo)) AS mp_id_externo,
  UPPER(TRIM(mp.status_externo)) AS mp_status_externo,
  p.cupom AS p_cupom,
  ROUND(COALESCE(p.valor_total, 0)::numeric, 2) AS p_valor_total,
  TO_CHAR(p.dt_pedido, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS p_dt_pedido,
  UPPER(TRIM(mp.marketplace)) AS mp_marketplace,
  p.valor_desconto AS p_valor_desconto
FROM marketplace_pedidos mp
  INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.ped_id = mp.ped_id
  LEFT JOIN lojas l ON l.loja_id = p.id_loja
  LEFT JOIN rastreios ax ON ax.ped_id = mp.ped_id
WHERE mp.dt_importacao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim
  AND (:id_loja IS NULL OR l.loja_id = :id_loja)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR l.status = :status)
  AND ax.rast_id IS NULL
ORDER BY mp.dt_importacao DESC
